extraction.document_summary: DIRECT - AIA Term Cover is a Direct Purchase Insurance term life product from AIA Singapore Private Limited that provides cost-effective, flexible term protection without a savings/investment feature. It offers cover for Death, Terminal Illness, and Total and Permanent Disability (TPD), paying out the “coverage amount.” Buyers can select a coverage term (the brochure mentions premiums staying unchanged for 5 years, 20 years, or up to age 65). For renewals, the brochure states “guaranteed renewability for the 5-year term plan regardless of your health condition,” with the “last renewal age for the 5-year term” at age 80, and “protection up to age 85.” A 30-year-old male non-smoker example is given: about S$0.33/day for S$100,000 cover (illustrative, not a guaranteed rate). An optional Critical Illness rider can be added, with coverage for Critical Illness up to age 65. The plan has a 14-day free-look period.
quality_notes: Brochure text provides high-level mechanics (events covered, renewal ages, critical illness rider existence) but does not provide benefit trigger definitions, detailed payout amounts/limits for each event beyond “coverage amount,” or explicit underwriting/eligibility criteria.
Several numeric items are illustrated rather than stated as general product limits (e.g., the S$0.33/day example).

policies.quick_summary: A Direct Purchase Insurance term life plan covering Death, Terminal Illness and TPD (pays the coverage amount), with selectable term options and guaranteed renewability for a 5-year term plan regardless of health; protection up to age 85. Premiums are unchanged during the basic plan term, then reset at renewal. No cash value; 14-day free-look applies. Optional Critical Illness rider available (up to age 65). Other detailed limits/exclusions are not provided in the brochure excerpt beyond general caveats referencing the policy contract for exclusions and conditions. Premium/example figures are illustrative.

important_caveats: No savings/investment feature; there is no cash value if the policy ends or if terminated prematurely.
